notes: Seed elections page works over https. No Clarity or vendor site found. The county posts Hart PDF reports (Cumulative and Precinct) on its OpenCms site; link hrefs use backslashes, fetched with forward slashes. Last-Modified headers vary per file and look like real upload times. The 8:40 PM runoff cumulative file returned 403, so its content was not read; its county-total nature is inferred from its 'Cumulative Results' name and is supported by the absence of any election-night precinct file. 2024 general undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-D): no election changed. Verifier disagreement on 2026_runoff not resolved by new evidence; the runoff record is left as the research wrote it. Tried: (1) the commented-out night links on elections.html at their linked paths and in the 2026-05 and 2024-11 folders: 'EV AND ABSENTEE Cumulative Results-5-26-2026.pdf' (root and 2026-05), '11-05-24 Unofficial FINAL Cumulative - All reporting.pdf' (root and 2024-11) and 'prelim reconcile 05-26-26.pdf' return HTTP 403; '2026-05/8 of 8 locations Cumulative Results-5-26-2026.pdf' redirects to the county home page (index.html), not a PDF. So the 8:40 PM runoff file still cannot be opened and no printed run time or upload time for it exists. (2) archive.org/wayback/available: no snapshot of the 8 of 8 file; elections.html only at 20260526203722 (3:37 PM CDT May 26, before polls closed; replay host unreachable). (3) wayback-data harvest: zero captures for all three elections. (4) Check 4: Cherokeean Herald 'March 3, 2026, primary results - Cherokee County, Texas' (dated March 04, 2026) says 'Complete but unofficial results, with 16 of 16 Cherokee County precincts reporting, were posted by the Cherokee County Election Department as of 9:33 p.m. Tuesday' and gives county percentages only (lead, not a county file); the runoff preview has no results. Sweep pending. Targeted pass 4 2026-10-02 (targeted4-J): 2026_runoff LATER to UNDETERMINED; tag COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS to UNKNOWN (settles the verifier disagreement in phase1/verification/Cherokee.json). Finding: the fetch store shows the earlier HTTP 403 responses for '8 of 8 locations Cumulative Results-5-26-2026.pdf' (research-2, verifier-6) had the body 'Host not in allowlist: www.co.cherokee.tx.us' (this sandbox's egress block), not a county response. Re-fetched today, the root URL redirects to the county home page index.html, so the 8:40 PM file no longer exists there; the same redirect happens for '11-05-24 Unofficial FINAL Cumulative - All reporting.pdf' (root and 2024-11) and 'prelim reconcile 05-26-26.pdf'. 'EV AND ABSENTEE Cumulative Results-5-26-2026.pdf' returns a 'Verifying Your Browser' proof-of-work challenge (HTTP 403, twice); not circumvented. With no opened election-night file, the 8:40 PM time rests only on a link label in commented-out HTML, which rule 43 does not accept. Also tried: runoff Official Cumulative (post-canvass, CreationDate Jun 1, Last-Modified Jun 5); newtools.cira.state.tx.us/page/cherokee.elections (IIS 403, Cherokee is not a CIRA-hosted site); wayback-data branch: no Cherokee sweep, targeted archives, or targeted wayback folders, main harvest zero captures (sweep pending); check 4: two web searches and Cherokeean Herald articles 53216 (Nov 6 2024, county totals only) and 47468 (2020 general, not in scope); no per-precinct third-party page found.

2026_primary.fact: Rule 43: no election-night file survives. Previous: 'Unofficial Precinct Results - All reporting' is a 500-page 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results CHEROKEE COUNTY, TEXAS ... PRIMARY ELECTION ... Run Time 3:30 PM Run Date 03/05/2026', Last-Modified Sat, 07 Mar 2026 03:01:37 GMT (9:01 PM CST Mar 6), both after election night. No earlier precinct file for the primary is listed.

2026_runoff.fact: Rule 43 (DECISIONS 67): no election-night file could be opened. The night links survive only as commented-out HTML on elections.html: 'Absentee + Early Voting Totals - 7:00pm' (EV AND ABSENTEE Cumulative Results-5-26-2026.pdf) and '8:40pm - All 8 of 8 locations reporting' (8 of 8 locations Cumulative Results-5-26-2026.pdf). On 2026-10-02 the 8 of 8 URL redirects to http://www.co.cherokee.tx.us/ips/cms/index.html (the file is no longer on the server); the EV AND ABSENTEE URL returns a 'Verifying Your Browser' proof-of-work challenge (HTTP 403), not the file. A link label is not a printed run time or upload time, so the 8:40 PM county-totals time is not shown by any opened file. The only runoff precinct file is 'Official Precinct-by-Precinct Results' (Run Date 06/01/2026, Last-Modified Fri, 05 Jun 2026 13:47:07 GMT); 'Official Cumulative Results' has CreationDate Mon Jun 1 20:21:10 2026 UTC and Last-Modified Fri, 05 Jun 2026 13:47:08 GMT.
